title: Device tracks fine, app is junk
review_text: For the first few months, my Leaf Urban was reliable in tracking steps during the day – it often displayed more steps than the Health app, despite being set to read AND write from Apple Health, but I was able to accept this. However, after about 3mos, it glitched a couple times, where it wouldn’t sync steps with the app. More recently, this has been happening every few days. It doesn’t seem to matter which troubleshooting tactics I try – restarting the app, restarting my phone, updating the iOS, un-pairing the device, removing and reinserting the battery, etc. – nothing resolves the issue permanently. I can no longer go 3-4 days without it suddenly not syncing properly. I bought the Leaf so I wouldn’t have to have my phone on me to track steps – but now I need to have my phone on me to track steps accurately, since I never quite know when the Leaf will stop working. I’ve reached out to Ivy support, with no response. I’m presuming it’s an app issue, as the Leaf still tracks sleep every night. This device is starting to feel like a waste of money, and I’m not sure how long I will continue to use it, if the app doesn’t receive a serious overhaul.

Ladies it has everything a woman needs to tell her about her body, my advice is to gift the older version to your kids when they first start having a period. It will help them understand and give themselves grace on the hard days when we can be more sensitive to stress.
